notes: Account context: large developer org at regulated bank — devtools platform used by internal fintech teams.
Primary ask: enterprise-grade IDE copilot integrated into existing SSO (SAML) + enforceable audit trails and retention policies.
"We cannot have any model weights or telemetry leaving our VPC without explicit consent" — security director (paraphrase).
PoC scope: inline code completion, multi-file context, streaming token-by-token suggestions for low-latency UX, and pinned model versions for reproducibility.
Latency target: interactive completions <100ms 95th pct for typical 40–200 token responses; streaming with first-token <50ms ideal.
Throughput: ~500 concurrent editors at peak for team of 1200 devs; batching/caching must not increase tail latency.
Quality bar: low hallucination on auto-refactors; must support model pinning and deterministic rollbacks post-release.
Security asks: SSO (SAML) + SCIM, strict audit logs (user, request, model-version), configurable retention (30d, 90d, 7y options), KMS integration for encryption-at-rest, support for HSM-backed keys.
Compliance: SOC2 required; privacy team flagged potential HIPAA adjacency for some dataflows — want data flow diagrams.

Integration notes: plan to embed Redwood copilot into internal VS Code distribution and JetBrains fleet via private extension repo; browser extension disallowed — must be IDE native or sidecar service.
SE feedback: recommend Dedicated or Private with VPC peering; Optimize to tune batching profiles and quantization for latency-sensitive endpoints.
Commercial: procurement interested in 12–24 month committed capacity if POC passes security and latency tests.

POC acceptance criteria (proposed): 1) SAML SSO + user mapping works; 2) audit logs delivered to customer SIEM; 3) <100ms 95th latency for representative traces; 4) deterministic model pin rollout/rollback verified.
Notes from 2026-03-03 POC: streaming first-token averaged 48ms in sandbox but varied with sequence length — need tail improvements.
Follow-ups: SE to provide architecture diagram for Private control plane; AE to push SOW draft to legal; security to list required penetration test scope.
